While poisoned in this way, a creature has its speed halved by exposure to the potent brew. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Additionally, the beer shower extinguishes any fires or open flames in its area.

The keg robot sprays hot oil in a 15-foot cone or in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 7 (1d8 + 3) fire damage and falls prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone.

Any creature affected by the hot oil spray that takes fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute) takes an additional 3 (1d6) fire damage, and the oil burns away.

If the oil that remains in the area of the spray is lit, it burns for 1d4 rounds and deals 3 (1d6) fire damage to any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (1d6 + 6) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.descriptionHtml: mw,rw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.descriptionHtml: Viari halves the damage that he takes from an attack that hits him. He must be able to see the attacker.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: Walnut is a 7th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following druid spells prepared:

spells.name: Thorn Whip
spells.components: V, S, M (the stem of a plant with thorns)

spells.name: Pass Without Trace
spells.components: V, S, M (ashes from burned mistletoe)

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.descriptionHtml: Walnut has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put her to sleep.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.descriptionHtml: Walnut can attempt to hide even when she is only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

traits.name: Wild Shape (Recharges after a Short or Long rest)
traits.descriptionHtml:
As a bonus action, Walnut can assume the shape of a dire wolf. She can stay in this form for 3 hours or until she reverts to her normal form as a bonus action. She automatically reverts if she falls unconscious, drops to 0 hit points, or dies.

While transformed, Walnut's game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the dire wolf, except she retains her alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.

Her attacks in beast form are magical. While in beast form, Walnut can use a bonus action to expend one spell slot and regain 1d8 hit points per level of the spell slot expended.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Walnut makes two attacks with Foremother or her longbow.

actions.name: Foremother (+1 Scimitar)
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage.
